components.css: .ds-week { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 56px); gap: 12px; height: 160px; align-items: end; font: 11px Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: var(--cui-color-text-muted, #595959); } .ds-day { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; align-items: center; height: 100%; } .ds-day span { margin-top: 4px; } .ds-ghost { position: absolute; bottom: 18px; width: 100%; border: 1px dashed var(--syn-ghost, #8a8a8a); border-bottom: 0; border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0; } .ds-future { background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, var(--syn-track, #ededed) 0 4px, transparent 4px 8px); } .ds-bar { position: relative; width: 78%; border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0; background: var(--syn-chart-1, #008f88); transform-origin: bottom; transition: transform 0.3s; } .ds-today { opacity: 0.75; } .ds-bar:hover { opacity: 1; }

narrative.overview:
The admin console is a calm, white-card ledger kept in the Synapse chat app's colours: a teal brand for identity and data, a single orange for the one thing to do next. It is read by occasional office staff, so every surface is a plain card on a soft grey ground, every figure carries its period and comparison in words, and the densest thing on screen is a seven-bar week. Dark mode is a full second world, not an inversion: a deep teal-black ground (the admin login page palette) with brighter teal and a warmer, lighter orange.

The system is flat. Depth comes from a one-pixel stroke and the step from grey ground to white surface, never from shadow. Motion is a short entrance only (icons pop, bars rise, lines draw) and switches off under reduced motion. Status is always an icon or word beside a colour, never colour alone.

The dashboard is time-shaped, not KPI-shaped: the main chart is the current ISO week (Monday to Sunday, matching the quota engine's reset), today marked, future days hatched, last week as a dashed ghost behind each bar.
keyCharacteristics: Grey ground, white bordered cards, 12px corners, no shadows at rest.
Teal for data and identity, orange for the primary action and the second data series.
Big bold tabular figures with a muted word beside them ("98.1K tokens this week so far").
Monday-first week everywhere a week appears.
Light and dark defined as paired token sets in `src/styles.css` (`:root`, `.dark`, and `prefers-color-scheme: dark`).

rules.name: The One Orange Rule
rules.body: Action Orange marks the single primary action per screen; Chart Orange is reserved for the second data series. Orange is never decoration.

rules.name: The Paired Token Rule
rules.body: Every colour is a CSS variable with a light value and a dark value, declared in all three blocks of `src/styles.css`. Components reference `var(--syn-*)` or `var(--cui-color-*)`; no hex in components.

rules.name: The Login Dark Rule
rules.body: Dark mode follows the admin login page: teal-black ground (dark-ground), deep teal-grey cards (dark-surface), lighter teal (dark-brand-teal) and a lighter orange (dark-action-orange) so text on it stays dark.

rules.name: The Figure-Plus-Word Rule
rules.body: A number never stands alone: it carries its unit or period in muted 13 to 14px text beside or beneath it.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Numbers in tables, charts and tooltips use tabular numerals so columns align.

rules.name: The Flat Card Rule
rules.body: Cards and tiles never carry a shadow; a 1px border and the ground-to-surface step are the only separation.

dos: **Do** put every colour through a paired `--syn-*` or `--cui-color-*` variable defined in `:root`, `.dark` and `prefers-color-scheme: dark`.
**Do** keep orange to the single primary action and the second data series.
**Do** start every week on Monday and end it on Sunday; that is the quota reset week.
**Do** pair every status colour with an icon or a word, and every chart with a screen-reader table.
**Do** show token figures where allowance would go until institution admins have a tenant-scoped allowance endpoint; label them as tokens.
**Do** wrap entrance motion in the `syn-*` classes so `prefers-reduced-motion` turns it off.
donts: **Don't** put a shadow on a card or tile at rest.
**Don't** put white text on Action Orange; use dark ink (on-accent-ink).
**Don't** draw a future day as a zero bar; it is hatched and unlabelled.
**Don't** show allowance, credit or taka figures to institution admins from superadmin-only `/api/platform/*` data.
